Special Branch S.2.
September 28, 1932.

Memorandum on the movements of A.Y. Griaznoff,
Soviet Employee.

A.Y. Griaznoff, who is employed in the
General Office of the Chinese Eastern Railway,
Harbin as Head Bookkeeper, left Shanghai for
Harbin via Dairen on September 24, 1932 by the
s.s. "Hoten Maru."
He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on September
8, and resided at 16 Linda Terrace during his stay
here.

G Tcheremshanoff
D. S.

Information.

16/9/32

Special Branch S.2.
September 16, 1932.

Memorandum on Alexander Yakovlevich Griaznoff,
Soviet Employee.

A.Y. Griaznoff arrived in Shanghai from Harbin via
Dairen on September 8, 1932 by the s.s. 'Yoten Maru'.
He is employed as head bookkeeper in the General Office of
the Chinese Eastern Railway Harbin. He holds Soviet
Passport No.109798/120128 issued in Vladivostok on
March 2, 1926 which states that he was born in 1884.
He resides at 16 Linda Terrace off Avenue Joffre.

G Tchoumchanoff
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
Information.
SBR 16/9.
